Hey @OxygeN =D


At the time when you've been kicked out of the admin-team, you were already asking me if it's possible to reapply and receive a second chance. I told you that it's basically possible to reapply after a long period of time, but it's really unlikely that you receive any positive feedback. Furthermore I told you that you have to convince Sky, that you've changed over the past time, as there's a good reason why you've been kicked out of the team. Sky was trusting you and gave you the chance to prove yourself as a test-admin. Obviously you failed your test time and used your power in a wrong manner.


You didn't listen to me and reapplied after not even one month (Kick: 20.06.2016). In my opinion this reapplication is a quite imprudent step as it was clear how people would react to it. I see no way of giving you a second chance now. Your really quick reapplication just underlines the lack of maturity, that you still have.

End of my journey
